agentProfiles.name: Orchestrate
agentProfiles.notes: A change of more than one step, or one not specified yet. Plans it, writes the spec, starts Explore, Build and Review workers for the reading, the edits and the second read, and decides. Tell it to use the `orchestrate` skill. Not for a small change that is already specified: use Build.

agentProfiles.name: Plan
agentProfiles.notes: Hard design or debugging questions: architecture, root causes, comparing approaches. Reads and reports; makes no edits.

agentProfiles.name: Explore
agentProfiles.notes: Where and how is X: finds the code and reports paths and line numbers. Cheap; makes no edits. Not for design questions: use Plan.

agentProfiles.name: Build
agentProfiles.notes: A well-specified change: the goal, the files and the check to pass are already known. Not for open questions.

agentProfiles.name: Review
agentProfiles.notes: An independent read of a diff or a plan: correctness, missing tests, needless complexity. Makes no edits. Runs on GLM, a different model family from the Plan and Build profiles.
